golden_hazard_reading: The golden set is greedy text generated on the current pack (09-24 canonical-e12 baseline). The gate rule 'golden hazard <= 2 * max(base aa_hazard, 0.005)' tests for same-numerics levers. The Viterbi pack changes the weights by design, so its greedy text leaves the old pack's text within 0-9 tokens on most prompts. VIT's own A/A hazard is inside the band (quick 0.01609, full 0.00843). As written, ARMS-r3 section 7 says both gates must pass with no component outside its band. That did not happen: quick and full both exit 1. Whether golden_hazard should gate a pack change is a protocol decision this stage does not make.
